skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK Direct DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK Direct DMG to all enemies, then applies [No Revival] (ImmuneNotDeathMix) to all enemies that are not already death-immune, preventing them from becoming immune to death.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Direct DMG to all enemies increases 60% > 100% ATK. Still applies [No Revival] to all enemies that are not already death-immune.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20%. When battle begins, obtains [Specialized Protection] equal to 800% ATK (absorbs incoming damage, stacks with extra-HP effects; total damage absorbed cannot exceed 15x his original HP).

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Has a 50% chance to inflict [Specialized Burn] (DOT by 150% ATK. After any character acts, transfers the effect to a random target, disappears after transferring 3 times). Absorbs [Specialized Burn] DOT DMG on enemies to restore [Specialized Protection].

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc:
Inflict chance 50% > 90% Specialized Burn DoT 150% > 200% Permanently grants 30% bonus ULT DMG
1. [Specialized Burn] can be affected by HIT%/RES%. 2. [Specialized Burn] will first transfer to characters which are not in any [Unyielding] state. 3. [Specialized Burn] can be stacked up to 6 times. 4. M.Choze and Vaccine Man can deal Extra DMG by the [Specialized Burn] 5. [Specialized Burn] can transfer to [Revived] and [Resurrected] characters. 6. [Specialized Burn] can be affected by Formal Set. 7. [Specialized Burn] is not affected by [Evade].

effects.desc: PvP shields reduce or negate damage to allies.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
The death immunity blocking debuff is applied to enemies that are not immune to death, preventing them from becoming immune to death or respawns.
The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
Burning PvP tier — stronger burst damage, harder to deal with.
